Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mumbles happily, then wakes up and gasps) Whoa, trippy! I'm having one of those lucid dreams where I'm aware I'm dreaming so I can control it.

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: (Floats up, holding a picket sign with a picture of Candace) I voted for you, Kevin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! I'm gonna fly too! Okay, focus, and-- (Jumps off and falls, She lands with a thud on what appears to be thin air next to her bed. the whole landscape begins to crack and rumble) No! I've broken my mind! Reality's shattering before my eyes! AAAARGH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you're fine. It's all special effects. (Presses a button; Red grids flash and the place turns into Candace's room)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Special effects?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, cool, huh? Ferb and I are warming up before we meet our special effects hero Clive Addison today at the Science-Fiction and Fantasy Convention.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gets up) That explains why you're dressed in costumes from "Giant Losers: The Musical"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, I'm dressed as Captain Lump Sharkboard from Space Adventure XIV. And Ferb's dressed as Hymie Silverman, the elf prince from Stumbleberry Finkbat and the Whining Wand of the Turtle Wizard. They're the two biggest movie series of all-time, and Clive Addison did the special effects for both.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Stop being related to me! And take all your mirrors, and zebras, and junk and get out of my room!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Zebras? (Ferb shrugs) Anyway, Ferb and I aren't in your room. We're already at the convention! (Presses a remote's button) Special effects! (He and Ferb disappear, as red grids flash on them. At the convention, a camera folds up and a briefcase closes) Look at it, Ferb. (Camera pans to the convention building) Science-Fiction and Fantasy, together at last. (Camera pans to him and Ferb) It's breathtaking. Let's get in there! Hey...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Where's Perry?" is written on this wanted poster, hanging on a tree. And we see this little hand reach up and tear the poster down and the music kicks in all "Chicka, chicka, chow, chicka, chow, chow, chicka, chicka, chicka, chicka, chow," and the opening credits start, like one of those cool 80's TV shows with a voice over. You know...

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: A fugitive, semi-aquatic special forces amateur stage magician, framed for a crime he didn't commit, the 1865 assassination of Abraham Lincoln, joins forces with a rogue-trillionaire inventor-extreme fighting champion from the future. Together with the aid of "R.I.C.K.", their super crime-fighting high-tech talking rickshaw, they'll bring hope, justice, and varying degrees of aquaticness to a Tri-State area in peril. Together, they are...

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: Tonight's episode, Ham on Rye, Hold the Mayor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, in the future we won't sit and read newspapers in the morning. Instead, giant robots will control us in human death matches. (Camera pans to Perry, who is putting poker cards on the table) Well, that gives us something to look forward to.

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: Good morning, team. (Small monitor comes out of the rickshaw)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's up, Ricky?

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: I've detected some strange, out of character behavior from our mayor recently, which has me concerned. (His screen shows Roger, waving) Here he is from a news report a year ago. (Camera switches to the footage) Notice how he waves, it goes side to side, see? (Replays the footage in slow-mo) Again, side to side. (His screen switches to another footage at night, with two men. One with a clipboard, the other with a big scissor, Roger, and Bridgette Oshinomi, with a chopped ribbon) Now, here's footage from just two days ago. (Roger lifts his hand) Watch. See? His hand goes up, and then he transforms into a wolf with fiery, red eyes, and runs howling into the misty night.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now that you mentioned it, that is unusual for him.

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: We've got to somehow get close to the mayor, and find out what's going on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) We're gonna need a turban and a wig. And while I'm out, I'm gonna pick up some bagels. Anyone else want anything?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi Candace, Where are you off to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... I'm uh... going to Stacy's.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay honey. What's in the big bag?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cautiously) Smaller bags.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great! Have fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isn't it magnificent Ferb? Special effects extravaganzas just have a way of bringing people together.

Name: Albert
Dialog: (Dressed as a dragon, speaking to Irving dressed in a costume similar to R2-D2) If you think Lump Sharkboard can defeat Hymie Silverman, the elf prince, than you are three phlorics short of a foxonian zipfeller, my friend!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh yeah? Well, you can carry your own action figures! (Opens the hatch on his costume, and various action figures spill out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (notices Clive Addison talking with some other men near a sign) Ferb! There he is! Clive Addison! Do you have our special effects demo reel? (Ferb holds up the reel) Yes! I can't believe we're gonna meet him!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh! Phineas, you're just in time. Would you please tell this dragon loving heathen that the Space Adventures movies are superior to the Stumbleberry Finkbat movies in every way imaginable?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh...uh...uh... We're just... (He groans when Clive Addison walks away)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were in mourning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, it also took me awhile to accept the fact that I had no brother any more. (shoots a cursory look at Albert, who scowls back)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Irving
Dialog: They actually think all those silly magic elves movies are better than Space Adventure's epic science-fiction genius!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well I...

Name: Albert
Dialog: Stumbleberry Finkbat and the Lost Shadow of Darkling Tower alone, was smarter and more realistic than all the even-numbered Space Adventure movies combined!

Name: Finkie
Dialog: Yeah man! You tell him!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Realistic? Space Adventure is based on hard scientific fact. It's like watching a reality show from the distant future.

Name: Space Adventure Fan 01
Dialog: Affirmative!

Name: Space Adventure Fan 02
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Space Adventure Fan 03
Dialog: That's correct.

Name: Space Adventure Fan: 04
Dialog: Exactly!

Name: Albert
Dialog: As it should...a-be.

Name: Irving
Dialog: That fantasy stuff is for kids! It's almost as lame as dressing up as like...Ducky Momo or something.

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Fake Mayor
Dialog: Thank you for auditioning, but we're looking for something a little more dazzling for the mayor's ball.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No wait! We can dazzle, we can. I will now saw The Amazing Platydini in half. See? See? Platypuses, they're like butter.

Name: Assistant to the Mayor
Dialog: Mayor, we got this surveillance photo from the wig and turban supply store.

Name: Fake Mayor
Dialog: It's Doof 'n' Puss.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, Plati-padapbra!

Name: Fake Mayor
Dialog: Oh very impressive, Doctor Doofenshmirtz and Perry the Platypus! Now it's my turn to make you disappear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Ninja Vampires! I hate these guys.

Name: Ninja Vampire
Dialog: Wow, he's good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I picked the wrong day to stop carrying garlic scented throwing stars.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Picks up his phone) Hey Stacy, how's it going? No, I haven't heard from Candace.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What! She told me that she was hanging with you today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really? She told me the same thing about you. Anyway, I'm over at the Sci-Fi Fantasy convention with little Suzy. She's really into the kids stuff. You know, like Sea-Horsie Hospital, or you know, lame stuff like Ducky Momo. (Seeing a person in a Ducky Momo costume) Ooh.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Suzy? Wait, Suzy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Aww

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know you can't run away like that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the Ducky Momo suit) Oh, that was close. (She removes the head of the costume) Why must it be so hard for a lifelong, closet Ducky Momo fan to go to a Science-Fiction and Fantasy convention, and find cool, rare Ducky Momo collectibles, without anybody discovering her dark, humiliating secret? (She redons the head)

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on guys, aren't you blowing this all out of proportion?

Name: Irving and Albert
Dialog: No.

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Come with me Phineas, you should meet with the Almordian Council. They'll straighten you out. (They walk off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, what about Ferb?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Forget about him, he's nothing to you anymore. (pushes Phineas in front of him as he walks off)

Name: Albert
Dialog: (to Ferb) Well, I guess I'm your new brother. Carry my action figures?

Name: Irving
Dialog: We seek counsel with the exalted one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Baljeet is the only sixteenth level Space Adventure trivia master in the world.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I feel a minor disturbance in the universe, almost as if... (A toilet flushes, and Clive Addison walks out of the stall) Nope! Now it is gone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Okay. It's Clive Addison!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Pay attention! I have unfortunate news to report master. Ferb is... dressed like an elf!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, and his costume's really cool too. He spun his own wool, and the headband's made of--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh for the love of humillian dorphite! We lost Ferb too?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's not "lost". He's just enjoying another genre.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Never! The line must be drawn here! (gets up and shines a flashlight beside Phineas) Right between Phineas and his loved ones.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh come on. Did you ever consider that fans of Space Adventur-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right, speckies. Have more in common with fans of Stumbleberry Finkba-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe Speckies and Finkies have more in common then they do differences.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! Bite this prop tongue from episode eight! (produces said prop tongue)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have you ever tried talking to them?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Talk!? Have you met the leader of the Finkies?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm sure you're wondering why I, Buford, have taken a leadership role in such a geek-centered enterprise. Well, take a look around! This place is crawling with nerds! I'm like a kid in a candy store! Plus, I relate to the character of Odaf Underhump and his complex emotional inner journey.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I seriously doubt this will work. Buford is not a man of peace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nonsense, I'm sure he'll be reasonable.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! No space bunnies allowed!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am not a bunny rabbit! I am an Almordian Vanksloth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's time to end this silly feud, so we can all enjoy Clive Addison's special effects presentation. Baljeet, you prepared a peace treaty.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did. (Clears his throat) We Speckies vow to live in peace and harmony with you Finkies. All we ask is that you admit Space Adventure is much better than Stumbleberry Finkbat, and that you have brought eternal shame to your families forever believing otherwise.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uhh that's not what I-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh yeah!? You and what army?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your question makes no sense as a response to what I just said.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, how 'bout this? (Ties Baljeet's costume's ears into a knot)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (feels about on top of his head and becomes angry when he discovers the knot) Alright, so it is war then!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bring it on, Speckies! We're gonna go all Hyborian age on you!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is not even a real age!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Sighs) To quote Lump Sharkboard from Space Adventure Sixteen...Glorf.

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: We now return to:

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He and Perry are tied up inside of a storage closet) Well what did you expect? It was like twenty of them, against one-and-two-halves of us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look! It's the mayor! Get him! (leaps at Roger)

Name: Roger
Dialog: (After being wrestled across the room) Knock it off. I'm the real mayor, that other guy is a shape-shifter posing as me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know that's funny, you know, even while I was attacking you, I was thinking; Why did he tie himself up in a dark closet with us? Wh-what kind of a plan is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Oh, you've freed yourself with your amazing magician skills!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And also scissors.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now we've done it, Ferb! We brought the entire convention center to the brink of an inter-genre geek war. It's up to us to extend the olive branch of diplomacy. I'll go talk to Buford, and you can talk to Baljeet. May the luck of Sluffon be with you.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Always.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo Plushies. Momo Collectible Card Game. Momo the Movie! Oh, the Momo-ness of it all! The sheer Momosity!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Wait for me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy! Oh that poor sap in the costume.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pants) She's relentless! (She runs into the "Alien nest")

Name: Speckie
Dialog: Hey! No cutting!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Runs in after Candace) I want to see inside your head!

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: These Momo nuts are such an embarrassment.

Name: Speckie 3
Dialog: (Scoffs) Seriously.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo? Where are you? Ducky Momo? (an alien roars, causing Suzy to run out of the nest screaming) Ducky Momo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! Now If I could just find one piece of Ducky Momo merchandise I don't already have, all this would be totally worth it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've got to get to Buford, but how to approach it?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Working on your battle strategy, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What? No! I-I mean... yes! Yes I am. In fact, there's a way you can help me with it.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Me? Help you? My manipulator-slash-grasper is at your command!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! We'll need to modify your costume a bit to get you behind enemy lines.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Enemy lines!?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, Mr. Barbarian, Sir.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why do you disturb my brooding on the eve of war, stumpling?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I come bearing a message. (A holographic project of Phineas appears)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Witchcraft! What trickery is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Greeting, all-mighty Odaf Underhump.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas, your kind is not welcome here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just hear me out! In a theatrical landscape that's drowning in comedy, romance, and thought-provoking ecological docu-dramas, Finkies and Speckies are all outcasts. They should be friends.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There are no friends in these halls, Phineas. There are only my people, and those who must be destroyed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But that's jus--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hold your words, outlander! Once Odaf Underhump has made a hasty and ill-informed decision, he cannot be swayed.

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: Go home Finkie, your kind isn't welcome here.

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: Did you see that?

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: He just vanished.

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: He must be employing some kind of cloaking device.

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: No, it's an elven cape of invisibility, duh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My time is limited, Magician. I must gather my positronic impulses for the coming battle. Speak.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha! You cannot charm me with your silver tongue, Elf Prince.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And your magic rune signs have no power in this dimension.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This conversation is over. Transport him away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This day isn't turning out like I'd hoped at all.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: (standing behind him) I know how you feel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Clive Addison! We're your biggest fans!

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Thanks, man. Just too bad there aren't more of you out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's crazy! Everyone here loves your work. In fact, the only reason they're not in line to see you is that they're about to go to war over which of your movies is better.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh man, I don't wanna hear that. I became a special effects artist to join the nations of this earth together in peace and hope.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, what other reason is there for creating cool visual effects for film and television? ...Special effects! That's it! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do from this point in the day on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we'd better do it fast. Look!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot resist our superior technology!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (lifting his arms) Smell my barbarian pits!

Name: Crowd of Speckies
Dialog: Eww!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yuck!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's do this.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Draws his flashlight) Ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The coast is-- (Gasps) I don't believe it. That's the rare Ducky Momo commemorative plate where they accidentally printed the wrong saying. (The plate reads; "I Hate People!") Score! All I have to do is get over there without drawing too much attention to myself.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Charge!

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Charge again!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Eat laser, Hymie Silverman!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (After rolling dice against Buford) Haha! That gives me a five points weapon skills advantage. You lose an arm!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, it'll be back. Odaf Underhump has a healing factor of eight!

Name: Mayor's Assistant
Dialog: And now to present his various new, pro-ninja vampire laws, here he is, the totally, for real, Mayor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Freeze punk-fake mayor guy!

Name: Fake Mayor
Dialog: You want me? You come get me! (He then transforms into a giant pint muscled monster)

Name: Voice Off Screen
Dialog: Wait hold on a second.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, what?

Name: Jeff McGarland
Dialog: You can't just throw a giant monster into a story because you're stuck for an ending. It's lazy. It's lazy writing.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What is that thing?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (holding up a black box) I do not know! Those readings make no sense!

Name: Irving
Dialog: That's a pencil sharpener.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How is that information helpful at this juncture?

Name: Jeff
Dialog: O-On second thought I love it. You may have tied me up next to this-what is this? A beaver or something? (Referring to Perry) And, and pitched me a TV series against my will, not to mention holding up the autograph line. But my advanced TV executive instincts tell me your show is going to be a big hit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! I'm going to have my own show, on television! And then, all of these fans will be so enamored of me, they will do my bidding. (Laughs) It's actually happening! I am going to rule the Tri-State Area!

Name: Jeff
Dialog: Just a thought though, can we give the platypus a girlfriend?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What! Never! Oh, suddenly you know my characters better than me? Forget it! I'm no sell out. I just crassly calculated commercial appeal in a mad quest for financial gain. No, no m-my artistic integrity and I are out! Peace!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford! Just what do you think you are doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What does it look like? I'm running away, hoping that while the monster is busy eating my friends, I can escape.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Is that what Odaf Underhump would do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pause) No, no it's not. He'd never run from a fight.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Exactly, no hero would, no matter what the genre. And neither will we!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And, we'll win.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fantasy...

Name: Buford
Dialog: And science fiction...

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Together! (they pump their fists in the sky together)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Archers! Regroup and protect the left flank.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ion-Laser cannons, push him back to the center.

Name: Lady
Dialog: That'll be fifteen dollars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here.

Name: Lady
Dialog: So, you a fan of Ducky Momo? (giggles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, why do you ask?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! Look, they've joined together to defeat our monster.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh guys, this is soooo cool! Watch this man, I'm gonna make him lurch to the right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that thing? It's like a nightmare, or... (Notices the projector Phineas and Ferb are using to create the monster) a lucid dream. Of course! Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Brother!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you dweebs doing? Don't you get it? This is all baloney! It's just special effects. And even if it were real what good would this stuff do? Plastic blasters? Rolling dice? You think you could stop a thing like that by waving a wand and saying; "Oogie boogie woogie!"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe that actually worked. Huh?

Name: Kid 1
Dialog: Ducky Momo defeated the monster!

Name: Buford
Dialog: My people have much to learn from your people. You must tell me how to shoot a blaster someday.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Absolutely, and you can teach me how to wield a club.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm afraid that information is proprietary.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (taking off mask) Look everybody, it's me. Candace Flynn. I'm who you love! And I love Ducky Momo!

Name: Kid 2
Dialog: She's a teenager and she came dressed as Ducky Momo! Oh that's lame, even if she did save us.

Name: Kid 3
Dialog: She came dressed as Ducky Momo. Negative.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (putting mask back on) Man, fickle crowd.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! That was so cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy. You're not too embarrassed to talk to Ducky Momo?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe Ducky Momo isn't really that lame after all. Someone else seems to really like him too.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I love you, Ducky Momo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo loves you, too, Suzy. (She hugs Suzy)

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: I gotta say guys, that was, hands down, the best special effects show ever. And I've been at Burning Man. Your holo-projection device is brilliant!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Mr. Addison! That means the world coming from you.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Well it's just really clear that you two are going to have an amazing career in special effects ahead of you. And if that's what you want, give me a call in ten years, I'll hire the both of you in a heartbeat.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually what I'd love to do is direct.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh, you and me both.

Name: Voice over
Dialog: We now return to, The Platypus & His Girlfriend.

Name: The Platypus's Girlfriend
Dialog: Now Mr. Mayor, I will saw the amazingly handsome Platy-dini in half.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Watching the show) Ahh, he was right. This is better. I should have sold out.
